scripts.generate: dotenv -e .env -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma --config prisma/prisma.config.ts && dotenv -e .env -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.admin.prisma --config prisma/prisma.admin.config.ts
scripts.migrate:dev: node scripts/guard-local-db-command.mjs -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma --config prisma/prisma.config.ts
scripts.migrate:dev:admin: node scripts/guard-local-db-command.mjs -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.admin.prisma --config prisma/prisma.admin.config.ts
scripts.seed: node scripts/guard-local-db-command.mjs -- dotenv -e .env -- ts-node --transpile-only -P prisma/tsconfig.seed.json prisma/seed.ts
scripts.seed:admin: node scripts/guard-local-db-command.mjs -- dotenv -e .env -- ts-node --transpile-only -P prisma/tsconfig.seed.json prisma/seed.admin.ts
